name: The CTV Demonstration
source:
Anna Decot lives in an unnamed urban area associated and famed for it's advancements in android technology, but bad memories plague her as she remembers the horrifying experiences the field brought her into.

[From [url=http://www.renai.us/game/thectv.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
安娜·德科特 (Anna Decot) 生活在一个未命名的城市地区，该地区因机器人技术的进步而闻名，但糟糕的记忆困扰着她，因为她记得该领域给她带来的可怕经历。

[来自[url=http://www.renai.us/game/thectv.shtml]仁爱档案馆[/url]]
